mechanism_narrative: A quarterly increase in GDPC1 indicates strengthening economic demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as investors anticipate higher corporate earnings.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in > 50% of quarters with positive GDPC1 growth, or quarterly GDPC1 growth fails to correlate with subsequent SPX returns (Pearson's r < 0.2).

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS exceeds 1.5%, it signals a tightening monetary cycle, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as higher borrowing costs reduce economic activity.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS is above 1.5%, or the signal's Rank IC remains below 0.05 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in UNRATE below 5% indicates a tightening labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as investors anticipate higher wage-driven consumption.
failure_condition: SPX fails to produce positive 5-day returns in > 60% of instances when UNRATE is below 5%, or the mechanism's out-of-sample R-squared falls below 0.1.

mechanism_narrative: The interaction between increasing HOUST (new housing starts) and rising RSAFS (retail sales) signals broadening economic demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint effect of HOUST and RSAFS on SPX returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.1), or the mechanism's in-sample IC is below 0.2.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in INDPRO (industrial production) above its 6-month moving average indicates supply chain resilience, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as investors anticipate sustained economic growth.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in > 45% of instances when INDPRO is above its 6-month MA, or the signal's walk-forward Sharpe ratio falls below 0.5.

mechanism_narrative: The combination of a rising FEDFUNDS and a stable CPIAUCSL (inflation rate below 3%) signals a 'goldilocks' economy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors balance growth and inflation concerns.
failure_condition: The joint condition fails to predict positive SPX returns in > 55% of instances, or the mechanism's out-of-sample mean absolute error exceeds 1.2%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decrease in PAYEMS (non-farm payroll employment) below its 3-month moving average signals labor market weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as investors anticipate reduced consumer spending.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in > 50% of instances when PAYEMS is below its 3-month MA, or the signal's in-sample IC is below 0.15.

mechanism_narrative: The gap between GDPC1 and RSAFS widening above 10% signals a potential demand bubble, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as investors anticipate a correction.
failure_condition: The gap between GDPC1 and RSAFS fails to predict negative SPX returns in > 40% of instances, or the mechanism's walk-forward Sortino ratio falls below 0.3.
